publication_policy: One writer for finance-resume. Preserve original branches, archived inputs and dirty work. Own four-WP files only; source commits retained as ancestry with a selective tree, no whole-tree merge. No global acceptance.
test_policy: GitHub Actions only for product tests. CI.md snapshot protocol; reuse existing evidence by exact closure and request, never promote timeouts or setup failure to success.
